excluded: Tailscale installation, configuration, restart or networking changes
live task/profile fixtures or task closure
limits: Complete immutable all-history context over 128 KiB is unsupported and is rejected without truncation; a later item revision cannot shrink prior history.
Provider commands in acceptance tests are synthetic. No live model conversation was used to claim context restoration.
Current-run binding validation operates within the shared-workspace caller trust model; it is not per-message cryptographic or runtime-process authentication.

Cloudflare Web Analytics may transform browser HTML. Raw package verification uses Accept */* and Accept-Encoding identity; the actual browser path passed separate production-WASM and synthetic-vault checks.
